_comment: Central configuration for all numeric thresholds used by the pipeline. Change values here to tune behaviour without editing Python code.

bank_identification._comment: Weights and thresholds used by bank_identifier.py to score which bank a worksheet belongs to.

confidence_bands._comment: Thresholds used by exporter.py to colour-code rows and write the legend. 'high' >= threshold = green, 'medium_low' <= conf < 'high' = amber, below 'medium_low' = light-red.

synthesized_rule_defaults._comment: Default confidence values for dynamically synthesized rules. Can be overridden per-entity by adding the matching key to the entity JSON (e.g. 'contra_confidence': 0.95).
